title: Ninja H2R Track Only
description: Tailored for Track-day circuits, the Kawasaki Ninja H2R Track Only is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
